name: Salt Carbon Fund
quirks: NZX-listed unit trust holding NZ Emissions Trading Scheme units (NZUs) — NOT an operating company: no revenue/margins/FCF, so valued on NAV, never a DCF. Reports on saltfunds.co.nz/carbonfund.co.nz; the annual 'reports' are scheme disclosures with almost no financials. The FY2026 FinancialStatements PDF in PDFs/ is the auditor's report for the OTHER Salt funds, not the Carbon Fund. Best data source is NZX: the fund announces daily NTA (title format "CO2's NTA as at DD/MM/YYYY: $X") and Rule 3.13.1 buyback notices giving exact units on issue ex-treasury. Fund is buying back its own units below NTA — units ex-treasury fell 47.2m (Mar-2026) to 20.9m (Aug-2026).
